object.name: TuneSettings
object.description: Tunes the ESCs play. ArmTune plays when the aircraft arms, DisarmTune when it disarms. ArmSource says how: ESCStartupMelody writes the tune into the ESCs as their power-up melody (AM32 STARTUP_TUNE) and holds the command stream while disarmed so the ESCs start, and sing, at the moment of arming; BeepCommand broadcasts each note as uavcan.equipment.indication.BeepCommand (1080) for ESCs that implement it; Both does both. Set WriteESC to Write to send the melody and ESCVolume (AM32 BEEP_VOLUME) to every ESC on the bus and save it there; it returns to Idle when done and DroneCANLog reports each ESC.
